adopt: Run it once and point one app at it instead of a vendor URL.
description:
Kind: runtime

Problem
Every app hardcodes a different provider SDK, so switching backends means editing every app.

Install
pip install awnode

Commands
  awnode
  awnode-mcp

Quick start
  pip install awnode
  # container image:
  docker pull ghcr.io/aitherium/awnode:latest
  
  # or full stack:
  curl -fsSL https://launch.aitherium.com | bash

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awnode/
